heading: Your Call
sub: The choice is yours — trade, business, technology, hospitality, or agriculture.
seo_title: Your Call — Pioneer Technical Institute, Iganga Uganda
seo_description: Choosing your path at Pioneer Technical Institute — explore courses across engineering, business, technology, hospitality, and agriculture.
seo_keywords: choose a course Pioneer Technical Institute, vocational training choice Uganda, PTI course selection

sections.heading: It Starts With a Decision
sections.body: Whether you're coming straight from P7, finishing S4, or already working and looking to add a skill — the first step is deciding which path fits you: a hands-on trade, a business role, hospitality, technology, or agriculture.

sections.heading: Not Sure Yet?
sections.body: Browse the full course catalog — every course lists its entry requirement, what you'll learn, and the industries its graduates work in, so you can see where each path actually leads before you commit.

sections.heading: Ready?
sections.body: Apply online any time — admission runs all year round.
